title: An A.I. Titan Resigns
summary: Also, a Brooklyn building collapse kills eight, including two children. Here’s the latest at the end of Thursday.

Jensen Huang resigned today as chief executive of Nvidia, the chip-making colossus he has led almost single-handedly for decades. Nvidia’s board had been leaning toward removing him after revelations of extramarital affairs with two women: an executive who reported to him, and a woman who U.S. intelligence determined was a Chinese spy.


Huang’s departure[reverberated across the tech world](https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/11/12/business/nvidia-jensen-huang-resigns) . He was something of a hero in Silicon Valley; a former Denny’s worker who had wagered the success of his company on A.I. before just about anyone else, and emerged as one of the industry’s most powerful figures. Nvidia currently controls an estimated 90 percent of the market for advanced chips used for A.I. systems;[shares in the company plummeted](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/business/nvidia-stock-price-jensen-huang-ceo-affair.html) after news of Huang’s departure.


Huang’s departure is also a potential[challenge to the A.I. boom](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/business/economy/jensen-huang-economy-nvidia-ai.html) . Under Huang, Nvidia has been the “central bank of A.I.,” helping to finance major projects. And in Asia, Huang created an intricate web of suppliers, all held together by his personal relationships.


Colette Kress, Nvidia’s chief financial officer, will serve as interim chief executive. Here’s[what to know about her](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/business/nvidia-colette-kress-jensen-huang.html) .


**For more:**


-


President Trump praised Huang, a close ally, for doing a “fantastic job.”[Some tech leaders have rallied behind Huang](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/technology/jensen-huang-affair-nvidia-support.html) , and Elon Musk said it would be “an honor” to hire him.


-


China has for decades[used romantic entanglements](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/world/asia/china-spy-espionage-romance.html) to compromise prominent people.


-


Huang is the latest member of a growing club of[C.E.O.s brought down by affairs](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/business/nvidia-jensen-huang-ceo-affairs.html) .


-


**From Opinion:** “Nvidia without Jensen Huang is like the Bulls without Michael Jordan,” Huang’s biographer writes.[Here’s what led to his downfall](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/opinion/jensen-huang-nvidia.html) .
